qa.a: Acrylic is a plastic sheet made from polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA). It is a transparent or coloured alternative to glass, is around 10–20 times more impact resistant than glass, lightweight, and UV-resistant grades are available. It can be laser cut, CNC machined and polished.

qa.q: Can acrylic be used for a stair balustrade?
qa.a: Yes. Acrylic balustrade panels are very popular — clear, frosted or coloured — and can be used for decorative stair inserts and lighting features. Acrylic is not suitable for stair treads, structural strings, or any load-bearing parts.
